name: Only One + R ~Higyaku no Mermaid Minano~
original_name: オンリーワン＋R～被虐のマーメイド美奈乃～
source:
Main character gets disillusioned with swimming and loses interest in everything at school. But his feelings change when he is reunited with his childhood friend. He feels immoral desire upon seeing her grown-up body. The swimming lessons turn into endless insults.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
